title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Roads Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project will rehabilitate and upgrade in terms of capacity, quality, and safety, about 160 kilometers (km) of Nepal's strategic road network, which comprise a critical section of the country's main East-West highway and its feeder road. It will improve transport connectivity in Nepal, with a focus on providing faster and better access to social services and economic opportunities. The project roads are also integral to the international and regional road network system that connects Nepal to India, and will facilitate closer trade integration and contribute to Nepal's export competitiveness. The project will have a transformational impact by facilitating national and regional integration.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Road network rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: 160 km of roads is completed with road safety features friendly to elderly people, women, children, and people with disabilities at appropriate locations Achievement: 53 Progress/Status: Contract for Bhairahawa-Lumbini-Taulihawa Road awarded in June 2017. Contract for Narayanghat-Butwal Road (NB-01 & NB-02) awarded in Dec 2018. As of end December 2022, the BLT road has been handed over to the division road office.
Physical progress in NB road has been slow with 75.13% for NB-01 and 74.23 for NB-02 as of 31 December 2025. Data Source: Monitoring reports and PCR by DOR

Output: Road network rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: 30% women participation in the tree plantation program Achievement: 43.8 Progress/Status: 43.8% of women participants (248 of the total 574) in tree plantation at BLT road.
Tree plantation program in NB roads is being implemented . Data Source: Monitoring reports and PCR by DOR

Output: Road network rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: Conduct awareness-raising session on HIV/AIDS and STIs to 500 communities Achievement: 514 Progress/Status: Total 514 (200 in BLT road and 314 in NB roads) community members and civil work labors participated in HIV/AIDS & STI campaign. Of the total participants, 304 (59.14%) were women. Data Source: Monitoring reports and PCR by DOR

Output: Road network rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: Conduct awareness-raising sessions on preventive human trafficking to 2,000 communities. Achievement: 2670 Progress/Status: In total 2,670 (1,920 from NB and 750 from BLT) members from all the municipalities and rural municipalities crossed by the alignments, and civil work labors participated in human trafficking and HIV/AIDS & STI awareness sessions. Where, 1149 (60%) women and 771 (40%) men in NB roads and 420 (56%) women and 330 (44%) men in BLT road participated. Data Source: Monitoring reports and PCR by DOR
